description: Tools that intentionally do NOT write effect_receipts because they perform no mutation. The Phase 4 coverage script (scripts/audit-tool-receipts.ts) verifies each tool name listed here exists.

tools.name: commit_claim
tools.reason: claim declaration written to assistant_claims (Phase 3) — not an effect_receipt itself; receipts are written by the tools that perform the underlying effects

tools.name: query_delivery_history
tools.reason: read-only JOIN of effect_receipts + delivery_log (Phase C L1)

tools.name: query_execution_status
tools.reason: read-only template_executions + delivery_log rollup (Phase C L1)

tools.name: get_channel_recipient_caps
tools.reason: read-only DB query for email channel attachment caps

tools.name: diff_template_versions
tools.reason: read-only field-level diff between two template snapshots

tools.name: read_config_doc
tools.reason: read-only config-doc header summary (config-doc portability Phase 1)

tools.name: check_config_doc_dependencies
tools.reason: read-only plugin/skill dependency gate over a config-doc header (config-doc import Phase 2)

tools.name: verify_imported_config
tools.reason: read-only post-build structural verification of an imported template+roles (config-doc import Phase 2)
